purpose: Separate mask-boundary calibration from removal of newly empty candidates and characterize repair/damage objects.

data.selection: sorted IDs [500:5000], 4500 previously explored confirmation images
data.annotations: original COCO, crowd semantics retained for COCOeval
data.fixed_slot_diagnosis: all ordinary GT denominator; baseline nonempty predictions assigned confidence-first with same class and Box IoU>=.50, then frozen

decoder: same as PROTOCOL_DECODER_V2: input-grid upsample, predicted-box crop, threshold, official binary export to original grid
threshold: 0.75/(1+(A/2304)^2), A=baseline exported predicted area; constants unchanged

variants.official_zero: original masks and original nonempty candidate population
variants.filter_only: original masks, remove exactly the candidates made empty by smooth calibration
variants.boundary_only: smooth masks for survivors; restore original masks for newly empty candidates, preserving original candidate population
variants.smooth_gated: smooth masks, omit newly empty candidates

identities: persist image_id and candidate_index in every COCO prediction plus candidate_records.csv for all predictions including empties; same forward, boxes, categories, scores and ranking
controls: baseline official decoder parity first three images
boundary_only count equals baseline; filter_only count equals full calibration
original candidate order preserved; no score-based reconstruction
interpretation: AP is nonlinear: report both conditional effects and factorial interaction, not additive causal percentages. Boundary-only estimand applies to masks that remain nonempty; emptied masks retain baseline in this counterfactual.

object_analysis.existing_records: coverage/purity, baseline mask area inferred when TP>0, GT shape and GT adjacency are explanatory only
object_analysis.denominators: repair/failure, damage/success and net/all matched within each group; no-slot GT retained separately for overall recall
object_analysis.inference_limit: GT-derived variables and post-calibration removal fraction do not establish a deployable pre-calibration risk predictor

limitations: single model and previously explored data
no parameter fitting or rule selection on these results
fixed-slot recall is not official COCO recall
preserves established predict path, not a new claim of full model.val identity
